name: Market-clock books transferred to IF/IH/IC from common listing date
sample: Index research calendar 2015-04-16 through 2021-12-31, beginning when IF, IH, and IC are all listed. IF data from 2015-01-05 may be used only as factor warmup; IH and IC data begin on their listing date. Actual signals begin only after rolling factor and z-score warmup requirements in the existing implementation are met. Backtest returns, ledgers, annual outputs, and charts start on the first date with any nonzero strategy target; do not output earlier warmup dates. Exclude IM. Read only index research minute shards, index research fees, and index research roll-yield data. Do not read 2022 or 2026; do not read 2023-2025 locked partitions.
pool: Fixed equal-weight pool of IF, IH, and IC; split gross exposure by three instruments.

parameters.duration_threshold: 55th percentile of absolute one-minute price changes over the prior 250 trading days, excluding the current day
parameters.zscore: per instrument and factor, trailing 250 observations excluding the current day, minimum 125, clipped to +/-3
parameters.roll_yield: main_sub annualized_yield computed from contract daily settlement prices: main = RiceQuant get_dominant rule 0, sub = the largest same-day open interest among contracts maturing after the main, yield = (main - sub) / sub, annualized by 365 / |maturity gap in days|; lagged one trading day

execution.commission: historical index fees, by-money rate x1.01 and by-volume rate +0.01 CNY/lot
execution.slippage: one prior-year tick estimated from index minute data per side
execution.decision: close-known signal executed at the next trading day's first bar open; unchanged target keeps lots

reporting: Report both books and calendar-year results only from the first nonzero target date; exclude pre-signal warmup rows from output files and plots. Preserve the common-listed calendar start as protocol metadata. The commodity strategy was fixed before this index transfer test; this is not independent validation or a deployable-edge claim.
roll_yield_method: RiceQuant get_roll_yield returns None for index futures. Contract-daily calculation was checked against RiceQuant commodity main_sub on RB, CU, and M in 2018-2019: sub contract matched 1461/1461 days and annualized_yield error was below 2e-15.
known_constraints: IC carry is positive on 99.6% of days and IF/IH on 83%/73%, so the short leg can rarely trade IC. IM listed in 2022 and is excluded.
